Brookhaven Secrets and Mysteries - Museum Paintings

item.name: Mr. Brookhaven
item.role: Founder and first mayor of Brookhaven
item.cardSummary: Mr. Brookhaven helped establish the town and appears throughout its historical clues, movie tapes, portraits, and messages tied to the Agency conflict.
item.keyClue: A museum wedding portrait and movie-code scenes connect him to Madison and Brookhaven's founding, while mausoleum notes place him in conflict with Greed.
item.identityNote: Notes signed Mr. B may refer to him, but the source does not establish that identity, so Mr. B is not treated as a separate character.

item.name: Madison Brookhaven
item.role: Wife of Mr. Brookhaven and mother of Marcus Brookhaven
item.cardSummary: Madison is part of Brookhaven's founding family, and her notes record concern about the Agency as its influence grows across the town.
item.keyClue: Lake Madison carries her name, and a signed message hidden at the Movie Set warns that the Agency is continuing to grow.

item.name: Marcus Brookhaven
item.role: Son of Mr. and Madison Brookhaven; depicted as an FBI agent
item.cardSummary: Marcus appears in the Brookhaven family story and in Agency-adjacent clues, including a photograph, a laptop message, and a short signed note.
item.keyClue: A note signed Marcus says that the Agency likes money, linking him to an Agency puzzle without settling where his loyalty lies.
item.identityNote: Sources depict Marcus in an FBI uniform and connect him to Agency clues, but they do not establish that he is a confirmed double agent.

item.name: Greed
item.role: Founder of the Agency and a major antagonist in Brookhaven lore
item.cardSummary: Greed is associated with the Agency's pursuit of power and appears through portraits, hidden-room messages, a grave, and quest notes connected to Mr. Brookhaven.
item.keyClue: A hidden message calls Mr. Brookhaven his brother and declares that Greed has become king after their conflict.
item.identityNote: Some messages are unsigned and attributed to Greed from their location and themes, so those claims should remain described as associated or believed to be his.

item.name: Brave
item.cardSummary: Brave appears in castle and museum portraits and in quest clues that associate the figure with bravery, protection, faith, and awakening.
item.keyClue: A hidden castle portrait of Brave triggers a sound connected to other lore discoveries, and museum clues pair the figure with the message Faith Awake.
item.identityNote: Brave is a named figure in portraits and quest clues; the available evidence does not establish a separate civilian identity.
